data.title: Golf Place Terraces
data.about:
Introducing Golf Place Terraces. These are the finest luxury golf villas crafted by Emaar. They have released only 128 limited edition golf course villas with 4, 5, 6 BR options. 

Offering amazing views of the golf course, Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai, these homes are the highest levels of luxury. The villas at have the first ever, uniquely designed sky lounge, 3 car parks and extra storage. Choose now and avail exciting payment plans.

characteristics_module.title: Finest Luxury Golf Villas
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Book now and pay 60% during construction
  • Pay 40% over 2 years after moving in
  • Get 50% waiver on the Dubai Land Registration fee
  • 4 BR villas start at AED 7 million
  • Views of the 18-hole championship golf course
  • An asset for your property portfolio
  • Only 128 limited edition release with first-ever sky lounge

location_tile.title: Nestled inside Dubai Hills Estate
location_tile.description:
With direct access via Al Marabea Road, Golf Place Terraces is nestled inside Dubai Hills Estate. It is a few minutes drive from Downtown Dubai. They are also very close to Dubai Hills Mall and Dubai Hills Park.

  • 05 mins – Dubai Hills Park & Mall
  • 10 mins – Burj Al Arab
  • 20 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 25 mins – Dubai International Airport
